clauses.current_legal_basis: The held Federal Register original (44 FR 1073, 1979-01-04) was read in full: it establishes an official seal for the Office of Administration with no end date, condition or sunset, and no held later instrument amends, revokes or supersedes it. Bounded machine searches read for coverage and judged adequate for this order: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, citations of the order by number in statute text and notes, edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML, text naming the order), and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes of 6941 catalog records and operative sentences in 17521 saved order texts naming the order as amended, revoked or superseded). Each returned 0 hits for EO 12112, and the only held text citing the order by number other than the original is the 1989 OFR codification note.
clauses.reason: The sole operative section of the held original establishes an official seal for the Office of Administration in the Executive Office of the President and describes its design (Sec. 1-101), and provides that the seal shall be of the design attached to the order and made part of it (Sec. 1-102). The text states no end date, expiry or terminating condition, and the description of the seal is a continuing specification rather than a performance deadline. No held later instrument amends or revokes either section.

research_rationale:
EO 12112 (44 FR 1073) of January 2, 1979 establishes an official seal for the Office of Administration. The held original was read in full and confirmed to be the order (title, date and subject agree with the register row). The single clause covers both sections. With no own-terms end, no held later amendment, revocation or supersession, and no hit in any of the three bounded searches, the seal specification is carried as operative through 2026-10-14 on the original-plus-bounded-search route.
